AuditEventResponse.description: One audit row for the admin viewer. ``metadata`` is non-sensitive by construction.
AuditEventResponse.title: AuditEventResponse

Citation.description: A validated inline citation, resolved to its source for the UI.
Citation.title: Citation

CitationOut.description: A justification's citation resolved to its source (hydrated for the UI).
CitationOut.title: CitationOut

DocumentStatus.description: Lifecycle state of a document in the ingestion pipeline.
DocumentStatus.title: DocumentStatus

ExportResponse.description: A report export at any lifecycle stage (the storage key is internal, never exposed).
ExportResponse.title: ExportResponse

Justification.description: A claim supporting the recommendation, grounded in ≥1 numbered source.
Justification.title: Justification

Permission.description: Collection access level. Ordered read < write < manage (see rules.py).
Permission.title: Permission

RecommendationResponse.description:
A recommendation outcome — completed (band + grounded output + citations) or declined
(a reason). A decline is a valid 200 outcome, distinguished by ``status``.
RecommendationResponse.title: RecommendationResponse

ReportCitationOut.description: A section's citation resolved to its source (hydrated for the UI).
ReportCitationOut.title: ReportCitationOut

ReportResponse.description:
A report at any lifecycle stage. ``sections``/``citations`` are empty until ready; a
failed report carries a ``failure_reason`` (including the INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE /
NO_GROUNDED_SECTIONS content declines) — shown honestly, never as empty success.
ReportResponse.title: ReportResponse

ReportSection.description: One report section, grounded in ≥1 numbered source.
ReportSection.title: ReportSection

Role.description: Organization-scoped role assigned to a user.
Role.title: Role

SearchQuery.description: A hybrid-search request. Filters narrow results inside the SQL predicate.
SearchQuery.title: SearchQuery

UsageAnalytics.description:
Org-scoped usage over a window [start, end). Token figures are windowed; document/storage
figures are current (live, non-superseded).
UsageAnalytics.title: UsageAnalytics

get.description: Org-scoped usage over [start, end) (defaults to the last 30 days); owner/admin only.
One org-scoped, filtered, newest-first page of the audit log (owner/admin only).

get.description: Liveness: the process is up. No dependencies are touched.
